Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 6, Verse 4

“When one is attached neither to the objects of the senses nor to actions, and has renounced all self-will, then one is said to have ascended to yoga.”

Krishna defines the summit so the previous verse can be used. It is not a feeling or a milestone but a specific loosening that a person can honestly check for.
